# Canonical callouts

> Note body.

> [!info] Información
> Bilingual information body.

> [!todo]
> To-do body.

> [!abstract]
> Abstract body.

> [!summary]
> Summary body.

> [!tip]
> Tip body.

> [!success]
> Success body.

> [!check]
> Check body.

> [!warning]
> Warning body.

> [!caution]
> Caution body.

> [!attention]
> Attention body.

> [!danger]
> Danger body.

> [!error]
> Error body.

> [!failure]
> Failure body.

> [!question]
> Question body.

> [!help]
> Help body.

> [!faq]
> FAQ body.

> [!quote]
> Quote body.

> [!cite]
> Citation body.

> [!unknown] Neutral custom title
> Neutral body.

> [!warning]- Folded warning
> Fold metadata remains semantic.
